title: SRI pay stub to Puharich's Lab Nine

tellings.quote: disappeared. Not true. There's a a pay stub in Puharich's archives that is a is from SRI to lab nine Puharich's lab from 73.

plain: A 1973 pay stub from SRI, a research institute in California, to Lab Nine, the private lab of the researcher Andrija Puharich in Ossining, New York, is said to sit in Puharich's archives. Greg Malatzi, a researcher who has gone through those archives, uses it to dismiss the claim that something "disappeared" with a flat "Not true," and he ties it to Hal Puthoff, a physicist at SRI. If genuine, the stub would show that money moved from SRI to Puharich's lab that year.
